caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur, rendered in realistic detail and centered against a plain beige background. The spur is predominantly dark brown with shades of bronze and metallic highlights, giving it a slightly worn appearance. The main body of the spur features ornate engraved patterns and circular designs, as well as a riveted circular plate and a decorative cross-hatch motif. Extending from the body, the rowel (the spiked wheel) is large, circular, and has multiple pointed spikes radiating outward. Attached to the back, a curved band forms the heel band, with a small, hinged, segmented metal chain hanging from a side clasp. The composition is minimalist, with the spur isolated and no other objects or background elements included.
title: Spur
